text.content:
The Thermometer (@UUID[JournalEntry.b13NIR35K7HpthZv]{FIRSTLIGHT's Thermometer}) is a number. This chapter gives it a face. Three times during @UUID[JournalEntry.ll97TEj4MRjtM595]{Chapter 7 · The Ward File}, the table leaves its vampires behind and takes up the hunters of the Puget Cell: a van outside Helen's place, a conference room in South Lake Union with a delivery nobody asked for, a warehouse at the port on the night of the raid. These are the “From the Other Side” interludes (@UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS]{From the Other Side · FIRSTLIGHT Interludes}).

Everything in this folder is new content, written for the module. The facts in the docs (Okafor, Hale, the tactical team, Ransom, the arsenal, Northline, the raid) don't change. What was invented to make it playable is marked Proposed: the Storyteller decides whether to use it.

Journal What's in it
This one How to use the interludes, Hunter on One Page, the Puget Cell (@UUID[JournalEntry.dnsWkdXVJ19riBLa.JournalEntryPage.O8yPSIYLlTrKHm8G]{The Puget Cell}), and what each interlude leaves for the raid (@UUID[JournalEntry.dnsWkdXVJ19riBLa.JournalEntryPage.8DXPPUEUUp5bHka5]{INT-00 · Advantages and Cracks for the Raid})
@UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS]{From the Other Side · FIRSTLIGHT Interludes} @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} · The White Van · @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.hcNJvEh25hCamG2B]{INT-02 · SEA-0411} · SEA-0411 · @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} · Artificial Daylight
@UUID[JournalEntry.LfywH6qtS3GxDxJx]{The Puget Cell · Pregenerated Characters} One page per hunter, to hand to the player
@UUID[JournalEntry.jiea701LDJdMoHoY]{Red Tide · Continuation After FIN-D} The continuation after @UUID[JournalEntry.oyw1B5aZ7G2vFDuO.JournalEntryPage.on9MlxGjJpFF8yf2]{FIN-D · Red Tide}: premise, hooks, and the optional crossover with Del Velo a la Vigilia

What They Are

Short scenes, 30 to 45 minutes, in which the players run FIRSTLIGHT's hunters. They don't change the coterie's plot: nobody finds out there who ARCHER is or where the drive is. What they do is show, from the other side, what the Thermometer measures. What the hunters decide moves the Thermometer or gives FIRSTLIGHT an advantage in the raid (@UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid}). Sometimes, a crack.

Interlude When Where What's at stake
@UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} · The White Van On crossing threshold 3 Market Street, Ballard (@UUID[JournalEntry.YD0Td8Y9aJyIpGSl]{Helen Ward's Apartment}) Passive surveillance of Helen. The players see, from outside, the scene their vampires just played
@UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.hcNJvEh25hCamG2B]{INT-02 · SEA-0411} · SEA-0411 Night 5, at 8:00 p.m. Northline (@UUID[JournalEntry.KioeAEZP78U0Coz5]{Northline Cyber Advisory}) ARCHER's second delivery. Okafor and Hale decide how much to trust the source
@UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} · Artificial Daylight Threshold 9, Night 8, before @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid} A warehouse at the port and the target The briefing and the breach of the raid, until the scene switches to being played with the coterie

When to Cut

An interlude interrupts the chronicle, so slot it in where the chronicle is already taking a breath:

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} is played right after the scene that took the Thermometer to 3. Usually that's @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE} (the camera on 3B) or ARCHER's first delivery on Night 2. If the threshold comes later, that works too: the van shows up late, the way vans do.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.hcNJvEh25hCamG2B]{INT-02 · SEA-0411} is played as a flashback at the end of Night 5, once the coterie has decided what to do about Lonnie (@UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.5Vgl8slqjXlVRbie]{A2-E06 · The One Who Kept One}). If it's played earlier, the players will know Okafor is waiting for them at the Denny's. It's not serious, but the surprise is lost.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} is played at the start of the Night 8 session, before @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid}. The players know what's coming. Their vampires don't. That's the point.

Who Plays Whom

Six pregenerated characters (@UUID[JournalEntry.LfywH6qtS3GxDxJx]{The Puget Cell · Pregenerated Characters}). You don't need all of them in every interlude:

Okafor Hale Ransom Navarro Pak Sorensen
@UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} by radio in the van driving in the van the drone optional
@UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.hcNJvEh25hCamG2B]{INT-02 · SEA-0411} yes yes escort optional optional —
@UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} yes yes yes yes yes yes

Have each player choose a hunter the first time and keep them. If someone is left without a hunter in an interlude, they can run an operator from @UUID[Actor.abaWg7NwNQvM0sDc]{FIRSTLIGHT Tactical Team} with the simplified sheet, or play ARCHER, the radio, the rain.

What the Players Know and What the Hunters Know

The players know who ARCHER is. The hunters don't. There's only one rule: play what your hunter knows. The Storyteller can ask, “How does Hale know that?” and if the answer is “Because I read it in Part 3,” it doesn't count.

Sooner or later a player will want their hunter to fail in order to protect their vampire. That's allowed, and it isn't free. Each interlude has an option that leaves the Cell empty-handed: if it's chosen, the Cell's Desperation goes up 1 (@UUID[JournalEntry.dnsWkdXVJ19riBLa.JournalEntryPage.O8yPSIYLlTrKHm8G]{The Puget Cell}). A desperate cell doesn't pull back: it goes into the raid with the generator running and no warning. Failing on purpose lowers tonight's risk and raises Night 8's.

How to Close an Interlude

When it's over, the Storyteller notes three things:

  1. The Thermometer. Using each interlude's buttons. No interlude moves it more than its table says.
  2. Advantages and cracks for the raid. In the table in @UUID[JournalEntry.dnsWkdXVJ19riBLa.JournalEntryPage.8DXPPUEUUp5bHka5]{INT-00 · Advantages and Cracks for the Raid}. Write them down in the notes of the Puget Cell actor so you have them at hand on Night 8.
  3. The Cell's Desperation and Danger. On the Cell actor's sheet (group, cell type).

If They Aren't Played

The interludes are optional. If they aren't played, what the docs say happens: on Night 5 Hale writes @UUID[JournalEntry.WW7eg88I0uDGj8ks]{FIRSTLIGHT, Internal Memo SEA-0411} and Okafor uses the delivery without believing it; the raid happens as written. There are no advantages or cracks.

With One Player

The player runs one of the new PCs, with David and Bear as NPC companions. In the interludes, Okafor in @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.hcNJvEh25hCamG2B]{INT-02 · SEA-0411} and Ransom in @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} and @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight}. The Storyteller plays the rest over the radio. The interludes run 20 minutes.

Safety

The interludes put the players on the side of the people hunting their characters. Go over the table's Lines and Veils (@UUID[JournalEntry.BPqr3MwJXyy5lXZz]{Safety Tools}) before the first one. The white room at Northline, with its lamps, is an interrogation room: if the table vetoed it, the room exists, but nobody uses it in a scene.

The bare minimum of Hunter: The Reckoning (5th ed.) to play the interludes. If you have the rulebook, the rulebook wins. The pregens' Edges and Perks are written in our own words, made for Seattle: if the book has one that looks similar, use the book's.

Creed. What the hunter does best during the Hunt. Each Creed has a Desperation field: the kind of action in which the hunter can add Desperation dice.

Creed Desperation field In the Cell
Inquisitive Getting information: documentation, breaking and entering, interrogation Okafor, Hale
Martial Physical conflict, with the supernatural or not Ransom
Faithful Direct conflict with the supernatural (physical, social, or mental) Navarro
Underground Stealth and subterfuge Pak
Entrepreneurial Building, inventing, augmenting, or repairing Sorensen

Drive and Redemption. Why they hunt. Each Drive says when the hunter is redeemed: when they meet that condition, they come out of Despair (see below). On the wod5e sheet, the Drive appears as Motivation.

Desperation. It belongs to the Cell, not to each hunter: a number from 0 to 5. When a hunter rolls something that falls within their Creed's field, they can add as many Desperation dice as the Cell has marked. If any of those dice comes up 1, the player chooses:

  • Overreach: the roll stands as rolled, and the Cell's Danger goes up 1. The quarry learns something.
  • Despair: the roll fails, and the hunter falls into Despair. They can't add Desperation dice again until they're redeemed through their Drive.

If the roll had already failed, there's no choice: Despair. The wod5e roll dialog offers Desperation dice to hunter-type actors and marks the result.

Danger. From 0 to 5, also the Cell's. It measures how much the quarry knows about the hunters. It's the mirror of the Thermometer: the Thermometer measures what FIRSTLIGHT knows about the coterie; Danger, what the coterie (or the city) knows about FIRSTLIGHT.

Edges and Perks. What the hunter brings to the Hunt that no one else has: access, gear, a gift they don't understand. Each Edge can have Perks that refine it. They're on the Edges tab of the sheet.

They're mortal. Health and Willpower like any V5 mortal. Disciplines work on them, except for Okafor's and Hale's Faith, which subtracts dice. A Kindred's damage is superficial or aggravated depending on the attack; for the weapons in FIRSTLIGHT's arsenal, see @UUID[Actor.abaWg7NwNQvM0sDc]{FIRSTLIGHT Tactical Team} and the Storyteller Screen.

Tests are written as in the rest of the module, Attribute + Skill and Difficulty. If the test falls within the Creed's field, the text says so: (Desperation: Inquisitive).

“Don't touch it until you can pull it up by the roots.”

A small FIRSTLIGHT cell, on a tight budget, opened in Seattle in 2024. It's run by Special Agent @UUID[JournalEntry.bJA2iRyDgbm2TcuK]{Dana Okafor} out of @UUID[JournalEntry.KioeAEZP78U0Coz5]{Northline Cyber Advisory}, 11th floor of a South Lake Union tower. It has analyst @UUID[JournalEntry.D611Mcr17F6HHEUw]{Sasha Hale}, two more analysts, six operators contracted as a “special counterterrorism unit” (@UUID[Actor.abaWg7NwNQvM0sDc]{FIRSTLIGHT Tactical Team}), and a liaison with the FBI's Seattle field office. The tactical team sleeps in a warehouse at the port, not at Northline.

The hunters (hunter-type actors, with the Cell as their group): Okafor, Hale, @UUID[Actor.5ywnpdrw93wmy235]{Cole Ransom}, and three named operators: @UUID[Actor.cacjzuu13Bv7mJH5]{Teresa “Tess” Navarro}, @UUID[Actor.yyJApTmnANPPdw3O]{Owen Pak}, and @UUID[Actor.2hdWrhkD65ZNl4Xs]{Lena Sorensen}. The other two operators remain the simplified sheet from @UUID[Actor.abaWg7NwNQvM0sDc]{FIRSTLIGHT Tactical Team}.

Desperation and Danger

Proposed. The Cell starts with Desperation 1 (a single cell, a budget that doesn't stretch, and a source nobody trusts) and Danger 0 (the quarry doesn't know it exists). They move like this over the course of the adventure, whether or not the interludes are played:

Desperation When
+1 The quarry beats them to something: the coterie gets the Pike USB drive before chain of custody (@UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46}) or takes Lonnie out from under their noses in @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.5Vgl8slqjXlVRbie]{A2-E06 · The One Who Kept One}
+1 An operator is seriously wounded or dies
+1 The coterie cuts Northline's access to ANOMALY or wipes the cold subject database (@UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.EjJ0vfVBCjTTb0QV]{A3-E02 · The Data Center})
+1 In an interlude, the players choose the option that leaves the Cell empty-handed
−1 The Cell gets something solid: an identified cold subject, Lonnie and USB drive 3, a confirmed ARCHER target
Danger When
+1 Each Overreach (see Hunter on One Page)
+1 The coterie identifies a member of the Cell: the agents at the Denny's, the van, Hale's face
+1 The coterie, or @UUID[JournalEntry.yaAsxCkCLf8CANL5]{Voight}, reads @UUID[JournalEntry.WW7eg88I0uDGj8ks]{FIRSTLIGHT, Internal Memo SEA-0411}
+2 Someone gets into Northline (@UUID[JournalEntry.KioeAEZP78U0Coz5]{Northline Cyber Advisory}), whether they're caught or not

Danger in the interludes. At Danger 3 or higher, the Difficulty of any hunter roll to go unnoticed goes up 1: the quarry already knows what to look for.

Desperation in the raid. When @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid} begins:

  • Desperation 3 or higher: the artificial sunlight generator is already running when they go in (advantage V4 from @UUID[JournalEntry.dnsWkdXVJ19riBLa.JournalEntryPage.8DXPPUEUUp5bHka5]{INT-00 · Advantages and Cracks for the Raid}, free).
  • Desperation 4 or higher: there's no megaphone. Okafor gives no warning. The first line of the dialogue guide comes after the light (advantage V5, free).
  • Desperation 5: Okafor leaves the car and goes in behind the team, with her Glock and her bad hand in her pocket. Her Faith goes with her.

In Foundry

The Cell is a group actor of cell type, in the FIRSTLIGHT/Puget Cell folder of the characters compendium. The six hunters are its members: their sheets take Desperation from there. Danger is marked on the Cell's sheet. If Del Velo a la Vigilia is active, its panel finds it too: it's the only cell in the world (see @UUID[JournalEntry.jiea701LDJdMoHoY]{Red Tide · Continuation After FIN-D}).

text.content:
What each interlude leaves for @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid}. The advantages belong to FIRSTLIGHT; the cracks, to the coterie. They apply only if the raid happens. None of them changes who wins: they change what each side brings to the door.

Name Comes from Effect in @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid}
V1 Face on File @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} FIRSTLIGHT has a still frame of a PC. If that PC is at the target, the operators' first roll against them gets +2 dice: they know who they're looking for
V2 The License Plate @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} The coterie's vehicle (Bear's truck or another) is flagged. Escaping in it without first bringing down the drone is impossible: the drone follows it
V3 Prior Reconnaissance @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.hcNJvEh25hCamG2B]{INT-02 · SEA-0411} The Cell studied that target beforehand. The known escape routes (the hangar's loading tunnel, the farm's boat landing) are at Difficulty +1
V4 Generator in Position @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} The artificial sunlight generator comes on the first turn; it doesn't take two
V5 Radio Silence @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} No megaphone warning. Detecting the raid becomes Difficulty 5
V6 Cordon @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} Two operators cover the water exit. The boat at the covered dock is no longer an option: it's being watched
F1 Ransom's Doubt @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} or @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} Ransom knows who Bear is and didn't say so. Bear's roll to buy a minute at the door drops to Difficulty 2, and that half-second of doubt is his
F2 The Familiar Van @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mnN2petGkva9YpRV]{INT-01 · The White Van} The coterie saw the white van on Market Street. In the raid they recognize it: Detecting the raid drops 1 in Difficulty
F3 Okafor Doubts ARCHER @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.hcNJvEh25hCamG2B]{INT-02 · SEA-0411} If someone tells her over the radio who her source is, Okafor doesn't believe it, but she orders a one-turn hold before going in. Talking to her over the radio is no longer impossible
F4 Noise at the Entry @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} The approach made noise. The coterie detects the raid without rolling and has three minutes, not two
F5 No Drone @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} The drone didn't take off or had to land. The team loses the +2 to Awareness and half its coordination from the first turn
F6 Covered Camera @UUID[JournalEntry.I3XsZ233TNTuehzS.JournalEntryPage.mZqnxdlJulTDtmtx]{INT-03 · Artificial Daylight} One operator has their body camera covered. Whatever happens in front of them doesn't raise the Thermometer

If an advantage and a crack overlap (V5 and F4), the crack wins: the noise has already been made.
